text:
Hi all,

Please keep routine Companion Animal Travel Desk checks moving in a steady, consistent way as travelers come through Aurelia Skyways. When a booking includes an animal, confirm that the welfare notes are complete, that the carrier details are clear, and that the customer understands the basic boarding expectations before the handoff to the airport team. If anything in the file looks incomplete, flag it early so the welfare coordinator can review the comfort needs without delay.

For each case, use plain language and keep the exchange calm and practical. A short confirmation to the traveler is often enough to prevent confusion later, especially when a pet needs a quieter route through the terminal or an extra pause before boarding. If a traveler asks for help with documentation, stay focused on what is already on record and pass only the necessary details to the next team.

Please also remember to keep notes consistent in the desk log so the next agent can pick up the case smoothly. Clear internal updates help us maintain a dependable process and support animal welfare across all passenger journeys.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
